Database.//: Deployed environments apply migrations from the pipeline, not from an app instance.

Auth.//: Entra ID. Authority is https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/v2.0 and Audience is the API's app-id URI.
Auth.//guest: GuestSigningKey: base64, 32+ bytes, from Key Vault.

Local.//: SpMS's own email + password accounts (no Entra). SigningKey: base64, 32+ bytes.

Authorization.//: Mode: OpenFga (an OpenFGA server, OpenFga:ApiUrl) or Local (the same model decided in-process from the SpMS tables, no server).
